questions.question: If an eleven-digit number 5y5888406x6 is divisible by 72, then what is the value of (9x – 2y), for the least value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

5y5888406x6 is divisible by 72

**Concept used:**

Divisibility rule of 8:- When the last three digits are divisible by 8 then the whole numbers will be divisible by 8.

Divisibility rule of 9 :- sum of the all digits of the number must be divided by 9

**Calculation:**

72 = 8 × 9. So, the number will be divided by 8 and 9 both

For divisibility of 8, we have

For least value of **x = 1,** the number 616 will be divisible by 8.

Also, For divisibility of 9, we have

the sum of all digits = 5 + y + 5 + 8 + 8 + 8 + 4 + 0 + 6 + 1 + 6 = y + 51

So it should 54 then

the value of y = 54 – 51 =** 3**

∴ the required value of (9x – 2y) = 9 × 1 – 2 × 3 = 3

**Formula used:**

S.P. = {(100 + gain%)/100} × C.P.

Discount% = {(M.P. - S.P.)/M.P.} × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the CP of the article be Rs. 100.

According to the question,

MP = 1.2 × CP = Rs. 120

Also, allowing discount the profit reduces to = 10%

Therefore, 

∴ SP = 100 × 110/100 = Rs.110

Discount percentage = (120 – 110)/120 × 100 = 8(1/3)%

questions.question: Sudha spends 80% of her income. When her income is increased by 30%, she increases her expenditure by 25%. Her saving is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sudha spending = 80% of income

Increase in income = 30%

Increase of expenditure = 25%

**Concept used:**

Income = Expenditure + Saving

**Calculation:**

Ratio of income : expenditure : savings

⇒ 100 : 80 : 20 or 5 : 4 : 1

Now let 5x, 4x and x be the income, expenditure and savings.

According to the question,

new income = 5x + 5x × 30% = 6.5x

new expenditure = 4x + 4x × 25% = 5x

new savings = 6.5x – 5x = 1.5x

% change in savings = (1.5x – x)/x × 100 = +50%

∴ her savings are increased by 50%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Let Income = 100

Then expenditure = 80 and income = 100 - 80 = 20

New Income = 100 + 30% of 100 = 130

New Expenditure = 80 + 25% of 80 = 100

New Income = 130 - 100 = 30

Increase in saving = 30 - 20 = 10

% change in savings = 10/20 × 100 = 50%

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 10000 amounts to Rs. 11664 in 2 years, at a certain rate percent per annum, when the interest is compounded annually. What will be the simple interest on the same sum for 27/5 years at the same rate?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 10000

Amount = Rs. 11664

Time period = 2 years

**Formula used:**

If interest is compounded annually, then

A = P(1 + R/100)T

If case of Simple Interest, then

S.I. = (P × R × T)/100

where P → Principal

R → rate of interest

T → Time period

S.I. → Simple Interest

**Calculation:**

Compound interest = Amount – Sum

⇒ 11664 – 10000 = Rs. 1664

1664 can be written as = 800 + 800 + 64

Rate of interest = 8% (∵ 800 = 8% of 10,000 and also 64 is 8% of 800)

Simple interest on sum for 27/5 years

⇒ (10000 × 8 × 27/5)/100 = Rs.4320.

41

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 8 hours and 12 hours, respectively whereas pipe C can empty the full tank in 6 hours. A and B are opened for 3 hours and then closed and C is opened instantly. C will empty the tank in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by pipe A to fill tank = 8 hours

Time taken by pipe B to fill tank = 12 hours

Time taken by pipe C to empty tank = 6 hours

**Concept used:**

Work done = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Taking LCM of the time taken by 3 pipes for filling and one emptying the tank.

LCM = 24 units

Efficiency of A = 24/8 = 3 units/hour

Efficiency of B = 24/12 = 2 units/hour.

Efficiency of C = 24/6 = 4 units/hour.

(A + B) opened for 3 hours together.

Work done by them in 3 hours = (3 + 2) × 3 = 15 units

Now C has to empty = 15 units

Time taken by C to empty this tank = 15/4 = 3(3/
4) hour

questions.question: If x + y + z = 2, xy + yz + zx = -11, then the value of x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 2

xy + yz + zx = -11

**Formula used:**

x3 + y3 + z3 – 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x² + y² + z² - xy - yz - zx)

(x + y + z)2 = x2 + y2 + z2 + 2xy + 2yz + 2zx 

**Calculation:**

(x + y + z)² = 4

x² + y² + z² + 2xy + 2yz + 2zx = 4

x² + y² + z² = 4 – 2 × (-11) = 26

As we know that,

(x + y + z)(x² + y² + z² - xy - yz - zx) = x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz

On putting the values,

⇒ 2 × [26 – (-11)] 

⇒ 2 × 37 = 74

questions.question: The average weight of the students in a group was 75.4 kg. Later on, four students having weights 72.9 kg, 73.8 kg, 79.5 kg and 87.4 kg joined the group. As a result, the average weight of all the students in the group increased by 0.24 kg. What was the number of students in the group, initially?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of the students in a group = 75.4kg

Weights of four students who joined the group = 72.9kg, 73.8kg, 79.5kg, 87.4kg

Increase in average weight = 0.24kg

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of observation ÷ number of observation

**Calculation:**

Let the number of students be X.

Total weight = 75.4 × X = 75.4X

After 4 students joining, Average weight of the group

⇒ 75.4 + 0.24 = 75.64 kg.

New total weight = 75.64 × (X + 4)

According to the question,

⇒ 75.64 × (X + 4) = 75.4X + 72.9 kg + 73.8 kg + 79.5 kg + 87.4 kg

⇒ 0.24X = 313.6 – 302.56

⇒ 0.24X = 11.04

⇒ X = 46

∴ The number of students in the group, initially was 46.

questions.question: If x is real, and x⁴ – 5x² – 1 = 0, then the value of x⁶ – 3x² + 3/x² – 1/x⁶ + 1 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x⁴ – 5x² – 1 = 0

**Calculation:**

x4 – 5x2 – 1 = 0

Dividing both sides by x²

x² – 5 – 1/x² = 0

⇒ x² – 1/x² = 5 ---(1)

Cubing both sides

x⁶ – 1/x⁶ – 3(x² – 1/x²) = 125

⇒ x⁶ – 1/x⁶ – 3 × 5 = 125

⇒ x⁶ – 1/x⁶ = 140 ---(2)

Now,

x⁶ – 3x² + 3/x² – 1/x⁶ + 1 = x⁶ – 1/x⁶ – 3(x² – 1/x²) + 1 = 140 – 3 × 5 + 1 = 141 – 15 = 126

**∴ x⁶ – 3x² + 3/x² – 1/x⁶ + 1 = 126**

questions.question: O is the center of circle to which PAX and PBY are tangents from a point P at points A and B. Q is a point on the circle, such that ∠QAX = 49° and ∠QBY = 62°. What is the measure of ∠AQB?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daa1a645caba0fea11171a77eb87170a4ea147fca36db3c56755abe9a38fc3ca.png] 

Given

∠QAX = 49° and ∠QBY = 62°

From alternate segment theorem

∠APQ = ∠QAX = 49°

And ∠BPQ = ∠QBY = 62°

∠APQ + ∠BPQ = 49° + 62° = 111°

∴ ∠APB = 111°

We know that in cyclic quadrilateral the sum of opposite angle is 180°

∴ ∠AQB + ∠APB = 180°

⇒ ∠AQB + 111° = 180°

∴ ∠AQB = 180° − 111° = 69°

questions.question: A circle circumscribes a rectangle whose sides are in the ratio 4 : 3. If the perimeter of the rectangle is 56 cm, then what is the area (in cm²) of the circle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of sides of a circumscribed rectangle = 4 : 3

The perimeter of the rectangle = 56 cm

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of the rectangle = 2(l + b)

Diagonal of the rectangle = √l² + b²

Diameter of the circle = Diagonal of the rectangle

where l → length and b → breadth of the rectangle

Area of the circle = πr2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e237ea035d7adf792c1ce3afa0e95352d762b07b1c19d22b6fe7534a4ffe23f.png] 

**Calculation:**

Let the l and b of the rectangle be 4x and 3x respectively.

According to the question,

2(l + b) = 56

⇒ 4x + 3x = 28

⇒ x = 4

l = 4 × 4 = 16 cm.

b = 3 × 4 = 12 cm.

Diagonal of the rectangle = √(16² + 12²) = 20 cm

The diameter of the circle = 20 cm.

Radius = 20/2 = 10 cm.

**Area of the circle circumscribed = π × 10 × 10 = 100π**

questions.question: Eight years ago, the ratio of ages of A and B was 9 : 10. The ratio of their ages 4 years from now will be 12 : 13. What is the age (in years) of C now, if his age is 6 years more than that of A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of ages of A and B eight years 8 years ago = 9 : 10

The ratio of ages of A and B 4 years from now = 12 : 13

Age of C now = A's present age + 6

**Calculation:**

Let 8 years ago the ages of A and B be 9x and 10x respectively.

Present ages of A and B = (9x + 8) and (10x + 8) respectively.

4 years hence, the ages of A and B = (9x + 12) and (10x + 12) respectively.

But according to the question,

(9x + 12) : (10x + 12) = 12 : 13

⇒ x = 4.

A’s present age = (9 × 4 + 8) = 44 years

C’s age = A’s age + 6 = 44 + 6 = 50 years

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f69844cd22a487ca7ee3b828fdb64c425d223d75c972439795558f390288db65.png] 

⇒ Total age gap = 13 - 10 = 3 units

Here, 3 units = 4 - (-8) = 12 years

⇒ 1 units = 4

⇒ 12 units = 12 × 4 = 48 years

Present age of A = 48 - 4 = 44 years

The present age of C = 44 + 6 = 50 years

questions.question: A 360 m long train running at a uniform speed, crosses a platform in 55 seconds and a man standing on the platform in 24 seconds. What is the length (in meter) of the platform?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of train = 360m

Time taken to cross a platform and man = 55s and 24 s respectively

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time traveled

**Calculation:**

Speed of the train = 360/24 = 15 m/s

Let the length of the platform be x.

Time taken to cover the platform = 55 seconds

⇒ (360 + x)/15 = 55

⇒ x = 465 m
